review_evidence: README describes a Lean 4 Homotopy Type Theory development with a large-eliminator checker, higher inductive types via quotients/private structures, algebraic constructions and topology/HIT examples.

The ordinary declaration scan finds about 235 declarations across 44 of 97 primary files, but many declaration-light modules use project-specific HoTT commands/notations or theorem/support imports; they cannot be classified as empty by ordinary Lean keyword counting.
Representative retained modules include GroundZero/Meta/HottTheory.lean, HIT constructions, group/algebra modules and GroundZero/Theorems/Ontological.lean; no exact disposable subset was proven.
summary: Retain the Ground Zero HoTT formalization and its custom-command/support modules.
